What the record says

  • The Seahawks' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is home underdog (all time): 74-53-2 against the spread, a 58.3% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is underdog of 7 or more (since 2002): 17-20, 45.9%.
  • On totals since 2002, the over hits most often when the closing number is 42 to 44.5 (76-56-1, 57.6% over) and least often at 48 or higher (22-43, 33.8%).
  • All time they have covered 52.0% at home and 49.6% on the road, a 2.4 point edge at home.
